modern-current-2026-ia.license: CC0-1.0 research snapshot; original official-source URLs retained per contest

limitations: Both99-county source inventories independently match the Census roster and all actual district portions. County compatibility is bounded to substantial changes; no same-seat/candidate or every-minor-boundary-change assertion.

2022 original MEDSL/Heideman county vectors are unchanged and retain exact upstream provenance. All13 FEC general-election candidate/scattered-write-in controls reconcile. Scattered/Write-In stays Other, not assigned to a major party or individual.

2026 all15 county→district candidate controls reconcile the exact registered source extract; this is same-extract control reconciliation, not fresh direct primary-body data. Native Iowa original hub and Clarity requests returned403; the readable official Nov4,2026 release describes current results as unofficial until canvass.
Current unknown source update times stay null. asOf references extract retrieval time, not an invented vote-update time. No all-ballots-counted or certified status is inferred.
Blank original party labels and source Write-in categories are preserved and normalized Other; no major-party reassignment or invented named candidate/zero.

Candidate-vote sums are not ballots cast, distinct voters or eligible-voter turnout. Statistical review cannot establish wrongdoing. Different nominees, field sizes, rules and provisional counting constrain interpretation.
